description: This file defines routing configurations for a Flutter application, including route names, route builders, an onGenerateRoute handler, an unknown route fallback, navigation helper methods, and a NotFound screen widget.

classes.name: AppRoutes
classes.description: Contains static constants defining route names and a list of all routes.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: Provides static methods to generate route tables, handle route generation, unknown routes, and navigation helpers.

classes.name: NotFoundScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget displaying a 404 error page when a route is not found.

methods.name: routes
methods.description: Returns a map of route names to WidgetBuilders for straightforward route setup.

methods.name: onGenerateRoute
methods.description: Handles dynamic route generation, specifically for '/steps', validating arguments and returning the corresponding route.

methods.name: onUnknownRoute
methods.description: Fallback route that displays a NotFoundScreen when an unknown route is requested.

methods.name: goSteps
methods.description: Navigates to the steps screen with a provided problem argument.

methods.name: goHome
methods.description: Navigates back to the home screen, clearing previous routes.
